style.description: Which recorded voice a parent's clone should use for the TARGET sentence of this Korean children's story. Judge only the TARGET sentence; the surrounding sentences only show the situation. The text may have no quotation marks, so decide from the wording whether the sentence is spoken by a character.

choice_descriptions.calm: The default. Even, unhurried reading, including plain lines and angry moments that neither a bright nor a hushed voice would suit.
choice_descriptions.excited: Bright, lively energy in a spoken line or in narration: delight, cheering, happy surprise, an eager suggestion, or playful action.
choice_descriptions.soft: Quiet, low, unhurried voice that stays voiced, not whispered: sadness, fear, hushed or tender moments, falling asleep.
